additional_info.subject: Update - Steps to followed to check emergency circuit.
additional_info.body:
Once Customer confirms that door is properly closed, we need to inform RC to check emergency circuit in charger and emergency cable coming for dispenser as well (This charger does not have physical Emergency button).
1) Check whether BG3 is working properly, we have continuity on point 13 and 14
2) Check whether we have 24V supply along XD9.
3) Trace 24 v supply in emergency circuit till QA26.
4) Check emergency circuit of dispenser as well.
